77: def bounded_json(path, value, deadline):
78:     """Return only after final IO, or leave a partial receipt and fail closed."""
79:     remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
80:     if remaining <= 0:

85:         except BaseException as exc: errors.append(repr(exc))

87:     worker.start()

119: def guarded_wall(budgets, deadline):
120:     reserve = (budgets["cleanup_reserve_seconds"] +
121:                budgets["finalization_reserve_seconds"] +
122:                budgets["io_reserve_seconds"])
123:     remaining = deadline - time.monotonic() - reserve
124:     if remaining <= 0:
125:         raise TimeoutError("TOTAL_WALL_DEADLINE_BEFORE_LAUNCH")
126:     return min(budgets["per_invocation_wall_seconds"], remaining)

129: def run_one(call, argv, cwd, env, out_dir, deadline, budgets, gate, authority):

131:     gate.recheck_before_launch(ROOT, authority)
132:     wall = guarded_wall(budgets, deadline)

135:     started = time.monotonic()
136:     receipt = {"call": call, "argv": argv, "cwd": str(cwd),
137:                "environment_names": sorted(env), "started_monotonic": started,
138:                "timeout_seconds": wall, "actual_exit": None, "stdout": None,
139:                "stderr": None, "stdout_overflow": False, "stderr_overflow": False,

146:     proc = None
147:     workers = []
148:     drain_done = {"stdout": False, "stderr": False}
149:     saw_eof = {"stdout": False, "stderr": False}

151:     def fail(code, detail=None):
152:         item = {"code": code, "detail": detail}
153:         with cause_lock:
154:             if receipt["first_cause"] is None:

158:     def note_overflow(label, observed):

160:                 "observed_bytes_lower_bound": observed, "cap_bytes": budgets[label + "_bytes"]}}
161:         with cause_lock:
162:             receipt[label + "_overflow"] = True
163:             receipt[label + "_observed_bytes_lower_bound"] = observed
164:             if receipt["first_cause"] is None:
165:                 receipt["first_cause"] = item

168:     def drain(pipe, label, cap):

171:             with raw_paths[label].open("xb") as stream:
172:                 while True:
173:                     chunk = os.read(pipe.fileno(), 65536)
174:                     if not chunk:
175:                         saw_eof[label] = True

177:                     kept = min(len(chunk), max(0, cap - count))
178:                     if kept:
179:                         stream.write(chunk[:kept])
180:                         count += kept
181:                     if kept < len(chunk):
182:                         note_overflow(label, count - kept + len(chunk))
183:                         if proc is not None:
184:                             try: proc.kill()
185:                             except BaseException as exc: fail("KILL_AFTER_OVERFLOW_FAILURE", repr(exc))

187:         except BaseException as exc:

189:             if proc is not None:
190:                 try: proc.kill()
191:                 except BaseException as kill_exc:
192:                     fail("KILL_AFTER_DRAIN_FAILURE", repr(kill_exc))
193:         finally:
194:             drain_done[label] = True
195:     try:
196:         # mkdir and receipt setup may consume the reserved launch window.
197:         wall = guarded_wall(budgets, deadline)
198:         receipt["timeout_seconds"] = wall
199:         proc = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, shell=False,
200:                                 stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
201:                                 creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP)
202:         for label in ("stdout", "stderr"):
203:             worker = threading.Thread(target=drain,
204:                                       args=(getattr(proc, label), label,

209:                                         budgets["cleanup_reserve_seconds"]-
210:                                         budgets["finalization_reserve_seconds"])))
211:     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
212:         receipt["timed_out"] = True
213:         fail("INVOCATION_WALL_TIMEOUT", repr(exc))
214:     except BaseException as exc:
215:         fail("INVOCATION_EXCEPTION", repr(exc))
216:     finally:
217:         if proc is not None:
218:             if proc.poll() is None:
219:                 try: proc.kill()
220:                 except BaseException as exc: fail("KILL_FAILURE", repr(exc))
221:                 try:
222:                     proc.wait(timeout=max(0.001, min(budgets["kill_wait_seconds"],
223:                                deadline-time.monotonic()-budgets["finalization_reserve_seconds"])))
224:                 except BaseException as exc: fail("KILL_WAIT_FAILURE", repr(exc))
225:             receipt["actual_exit"] = proc.poll()
226:         for worker in workers:
227:             try:
228:                 if worker.ident is not None:
229:                     worker.join(timeout=max(0, min(budgets["drain_join_seconds"],

231:                 else:
232:                     fail("RAW_DRAIN_THREAD_NOT_STARTED")
233:             except BaseException as exc:
234:                 fail("RAW_DRAIN_JOIN_FAILURE", repr(exc))
235:         receipt["drain_incomplete"] = (len(workers) != 2 or
236:                                       any(w.ident is None or w.is_alive() for w in workers))
237:         if receipt["drain_incomplete"]:
238:             fail("RAW_DRAIN_INCOMPLETE")
239:         for label in ("stdout", "stderr"):
240:             if drain_done[label] and not receipt["drain_incomplete"] and raw_paths[label].is_file():
241:                 try:
242:                     raw_pin = pin(raw_paths[label])
243:                     receipt[label + "_raw_complete"] = bool(saw_eof[label] and
244:                                                             not receipt[label + "_overflow"])
245:                     if receipt[label + "_raw_complete"]:
246:                         receipt[label] = raw_pin

248:                         receipt[label + "_partial_raw"] = raw_pin

253:         # A drainer that missed the bounded join cannot mutate the returned report.
254:         with cause_lock:
255:             frozen_receipt = json.loads(json.dumps(receipt))

259:             fail("INVOCATION_RECEIPT_WRITE_FAILURE", repr(exc))
260:             with cause_lock:
261:                 frozen_receipt = json.loads(json.dumps(receipt))
262:     return frozen_receipt

315:             raise ValueError("PACKAGE_TERMINAL_NOT_SINGLE_PASS_OR_BUILD_ONLY")
316:         top = {name: status for name, status in terminal.items() if "/" not in name}
317:         if any(status != "pass" for status in terminal.values()):
318:             raise ValueError("GO_TEST_FAIL_OR_SKIP")
319:         result["unexpected"] = sorted(set(top)-set(selected))
320:         result["missing"] = sorted(set(selected)-set(top))
321:         result["passed"] = sorted(name for name in selected if top.get(name) == "pass")
322:         result["skipped"] = sorted(name for name, status in terminal.items() if status == "skip")
323:         if build_only and terminal:

325:         result["package_pass"] = True
326:         result["candidate_pass"] = not result["unexpected"] and not result["missing"]
327:     except BaseException as exc:
328:         result["first_cause"] = repr(exc)
